result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Pedestrian Exposure
hazards.description: The crossing distance across the multi-lane intersection is significant without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The rounded curb corners may encourage higher vehicle speeds during right-hand turns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder patterns to increase visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and continuous sidewalks in a residential setting. However, the wide roadway width and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the street increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: Wide lanes can encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and curb ramps within a residential neighborhood. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands increase exposure for people crossing.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible, which can lead to confusion regarding right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalks to ensure pedestrians and drivers have clear views of each other.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and traffic signals within a residential context. However, the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance without pedestrian refuge islands or visible dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases pedestrian exposure time to traffic.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located directly in the sidewalk path, narrowing the effective width for mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the sidewalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.
